bodyTextCandidates.text: You will ruin a lot of good things by needing them to last forever. The dinner. The friendship. The version of someone you loved. Some things arrive, give you exactly what they were meant to give, and leave before you are ready. That does not make them meaningless. A song ending is not a betrayal of the song. Let good things be good without gripping them until they bleed. The memory can be beautiful without becoming a prison. Thank it. Miss it. Keep living.
